FULL TEXT:
Memo No. PSC-R(B)/13/2021
ARUNACHALPRADESH
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
ITANAGAR
ADVERTISEMENT
Dated Itanagar, the 12th May, 2022
The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission invites applications through online
from the citizens of India, for filling up of posts of Fishery Officer/Extension Officer as detailed below:-
Name of Post Fishery Officer / Extension Officer
Department Department of Fishery, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh
Pay Scale Pay Matrix Level-6 (Rs. 35,400-1,12,400/-)
Group - 'B' Non-Gazetted
No. of Posts/Vacancies No. of posts APST UR PwD
05 04 01 Nil
Not less than 18 years and more than 32 years as on 17th June,
2022. However, the Upper Age Limit is relaxable by 5 years for APST
Age as on 17th June 2022 and another 5 years relaxation for regular employees working under
Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh.
For APST PwD candidates, upper age limit will be relaxed for
15 years.
Bachelor's Degree in Fishery Science (B.FSc) from Govt. of
India recognized Institute/University. However, one who have
Educational Qualification appeared or appearing in the final year/semester examination shall
also be eligible to apply subject to production of original
certificate/Marksheet at the time of Viva-voce/lnterview.
1 Only 'Online' through APPSC website www.appsc.gov.in
2 One Time Registration on Commission's Website is mandatory.
{Once registered, all future applications for any post/vacancy
How to Apply can be submitted using Login ID and Password).
3 Submit only one application . In case of more than one
application, application with the higher RID only will be valid.
4 Fee has to be paid separately for each application and is non-
refundable.
1 Applicant's size of Signature in Black Ink on white paper should
Scanned Copies of not be less than 40kb and more than 50kb in jpg format.
Documents to be 2 Latest/Recent Passport size photograph (40-100 kb jpg format)
Uploaded at Application
Stage 3 For Final Year/Semester students, Bonafide Certificate. (100kb
pdf format)
1 Recent Passport size photograph (3 copies)
2 Matriculation Certificate with Marks Sheet issued by Board as
Self-attested photocopies proof of Age
of original documents to 3 Certificate and Marks Sheet of Class-XII or equivalent issued by
be submitted one week Board
prior to date of interview 4 Bachelor Degree Certificate with Marksheet issued by the
Assistant Registrar/Registrar/Controller of Examination/Vice-
chancellor of the concerned University to ascertain degree.
5 APST Certificate for APST candidates and Aadhar Card/PRC/EPIC
for other applicants.
1 Written Examination
Eligible Applicants will be required to undertake a Written
Examination in the following subjects: -
a. General English 100 Marks
b. General Knowledge 100 Marks
C. Fishery Science Paper-I 100 Marks
d. Fishery Science Paper-II 100 Marks
To qualify, an Applicant must score a minimum of 33% in
each subject as also, a minimum of 45% in aggregate score.
Of such qualified candidates, a number three times the
Selection Process advertised posts {Approximately 15), in the order of merit, will
(Two Stages) be eligible and invited for the lnterview/Viva-voce.
2 Interview[Viva-voce
A written examination Total Marks 50 Marks
followed by Will be conducted in the premises of the Commission
Interview /Viva-voce 3 Note
The Commission reserves the right to conduct a
'Recruitment Test' {Preliminary Test), if the number of Applicants
is significantly large. The 'Recruitment Test' will be Multiple
Choice, Objective Type, to be answered on an OMR Sheet in
Concerned Technical Paper/General Knowledge.
Based on the Order of Merit of the 'Recruitment Test',
Applicants, twelve times the advertised posts (approximately 60),
will be eligible and invited for the Written Examination.
4 The Final Merit list of successful Applicants notified by the
Commission, will be based on the aggregate marks of the Written
Examination and lnterview/Viva-voce.
Application Fee APST Applicants Rs. 150/-
Other Applicants Rs. 200/-
Applicants in Government Service may apply direct to this
Important Notes Commission under intimation to their respective Heads of
Department.
Syllabus The Syllabi of Optional Subjects have been made available in the
Commission's website www.appsc.gov.in
Last Date for Receipt of 17th June, 2022 till 1600 hrs.
